section.p: Consider a paragraph that contains a medium-sized image of a “dialog box” whose width and height are both larger than 50 pixels.

row.entry: [Normal]: The following dialog box displays the available network settings: [Inline image: network_settings_dialog.png (320 × 240 px)]

section.p: Result: If an image is equal to or larger than 50 × 50 pixels, the converter generates an <image/> element with the placement attribute as break. The converter does not wrap the image in a <fig> tag.
